When negotiating using unethical practices, businesses can risk _______, if the negotiations are part of a longer-term business association, as well as a ___________ and __________, as negotiations can impact company image and stymy progress.
Option A: Rigid negotiations, Enhanced reputation, Greater opportunities
Option B: Damaged relationships, Sullied reputation, Lost opportunities
Option C: Rigid negotiations, Sullied Reputation, Lost opportunities
Option D: Damaged relationships, Rigid negotiations, Lost opportunities
